title: Nerd.Nu Bot Relogger
description: A Fabric mod for auto-reconnecting bots on the Nerd.Nu servers.
body:
Adds auto-relogging functionality to the client for the Nerd.Nu servers.

This is mainly made for the Nerd.Nu servers as it uses specific messages that appear in chat to trigger segments of the auto-relog system.

Best paired with DynamicFPS cranked all the way down to minimize the client's impact on your computer's resources.
